name: refute_counters_a_spell_then_draws_one_and_discards_the_drawn_card
notes: Printed: 'Counter target spell. Draw a card, then discard a card.' Seat 0 casts Highborn Vampire (a creature spell, {3}{B}); it waits on the stack. Seat 1, holding Refute ({1}{U}{U}) and two spare cards, casts it at the Vampire. The Vampire is countered (it goes to its owner's graveyard, never enters). Seat 1 then draws exactly one card (the Drawn card on top of its library) and discards exactly one: the discard is chosen from the hand AFTER the draw, so the card just drawn is a legal pick, and discarding it leaves seat 1 with its two spare cards. Seat 0 draws and discards nothing.
